sections: TGS Steady-State Velocity and Position Discrepancy
primary_documentation.summary: NVIDIA documents that constraint-solver velocity outputs need not equal pose differences divided by timestep: position and velocity iterations address different errors. It separately describes TGS steady-state velocity bias when external forces are applied once per frame rather than each solver iteration. These mechanisms are useful hypotheses, not proof of the cause in this robot. The installed source defaults already enable external forces each iteration, so the documented disabled-flag example must not be assumed applicable. No solver parameter or settling criterion was changed.
